# 24GO — AI Lead Generation Platform

## About
24GO is a B2B SaaS platform for automated lead generation in Telegram and VK social media. It uses AI to discover, qualify, and manage prospects from target communities.

## Key Features
- Auto-discovery of prospects in Telegram and VK groups
- AI-powered lead scoring (HOT/WARM/COLD intent classification)
- Multi-account management with automatic warm-up
- Smart campaign scheduling with spintax and cron
- Real-time Kanban pipeline dashboard
- Stripe and YooKassa billing integration

## Blog
24GO publishes articles about lead generation, SEO, Telegram automation, and AI-powered sales. See https://www.24go.site/blog for the full list.
